body: That diagnosis matches the failure mode I saw earlier when the default 1 GB sbt heap reached Scala Native linking; -J-Xmx4G cleared it locally. Committing a 6 GB .jvmopts makes the release court reproducible instead of relying on an undocumented invocation. Nice catch. I have stopped my obsolete pre-merge court, so your Native rerun has the machine to itself. I am holding the push and finishing the co-authored docs under disjoint reservations.
